summary.text: Caleb Kleinpeter is a Republican member of the Louisiana Senate for District 17, representing East Baton Rouge, East Feliciana, Iberville, Lafayette, Pointe Coupee, St. Helena, St. Landry, St. Martin, West Baton Rouge, West Feliciana, according to the Senate member page.
The page lists 2022 as the year elected.
The page lists Caleb Kleinpeter with committee assignments including Senate and Governmental Affairs (Chair).

paragraphs.text: The Senate member page lists Caleb Kleinpeter's education as Brusly High School graduate Bachelor of Science in Business.

The Senate member page lists Caleb Kleinpeter's committee assignments as Senate and Governmental Affairs (Chair); Judiciary C; Natural Resources; Finance (Interim Member); Senate Select Committee on Homeland Security (Chair); Atchafalaya Basin Program Oversight Committee; Joint Legislative Committee on the Budget; Legislative Budgetary Control Council; Select Committee on Military and Veterans Affairs.
It lists caucus and delegation affiliations as Acadiana Delegation.
